version: 0.3 (2026-10-22; Depth and Shallows added as the sea grounds, B-13; 0.2 on 2026-10-21 took the vector mark from the Orca Solutions Signal v1.0 package)

paper.role: Ground: pages, carton, app background. The studio's Chalk; named Paper in the product

ink.role: Text, the mark, the box itself, the installer's dark section. The studio's Ink

harbor.role: The sea, mid: the one of the three sea tones that reads as text on Paper. Links, selected states, one line of emphasis per page. 7.0:1 on Paper

shallows.role: The sea, light: ground for the site's hero and section bands in light mode, the backdrop behind the box, covers. Ink text 13.7:1, Stone 4.4:1, Harbor 6.0:1. Never a fill for text, buttons or rules

depth.role: The sea, dark: the same grounds in dark mode. Paper text 9.7:1. Links on Depth are Paper, not Harbor (1.5:1). The Ink box on Depth is tone on tone; the product shot relies on lighting and shadow

stone.role: Secondary text, captions, labels. 4.9:1 on Paper

amber.role: The one warm point, the true contrast to the sea. On the box: the listening light. In the app: the listening state only. On the site and in print: at most one point per page (a headline's period, a link's arrow). Never text, never a fill, never a button, never on the mark

vermilion.role: The studio's accent (Orca Solutions). Not used on the products; the products' signal is Amber

shallows.role: The sea, light, in the monochrome theme

depth.role: The sea, dark, in the monochrome theme

product.role: The product's voice: wordmark, interface, buttons, carton, headings

record.role: The record's voice: Daybook entries, matters, long copy, the card's steps
record.source: Google Fonts, optical size 6..72, weights 400 500, italic 400

mark.clear-space: half the head's height on all sides

seal.box: debossed, tone on tone, about 18 mm, top surface, beside the amber light
seal.carton: blind-embossed in the board, no ink
seal.paper: printed in Ink, alone, never inside a ring, plate or badge

mark.eye: always a hole showing the ground; never a white fill
mark.status: Vector master: Orca Solutions Signal v1.0 (September 27, 2026), source/geometry.json. Primary path for 32 px and up; micro path (orca-head-micro-*.svg) for 16 to 31 px and favicons
mark.name: Signal

light.rule: the only lit element on the hardware

sea.what: One hue at three depths: Shallows (light ground), Harbor (text-weight accent on Paper), Depth (dark ground). The grounds are never fills; Harbor is Keel's only colored text
where: the site's hero and one section band per page
the backdrop the box is shown against: site, carton back, pitch
the inside of the carton lid (optional)
never: the mark (Ink or Chalk only; Chalk on the sea)

system.rule: Every Orca product shares the family two-tone, Ink and Chalk (Paper), and carries its own accents: the studio Vermilion, Garnet Guard its garnet, Diamond Dog its green and purple, Daybook its blue mark, Orca Keel the sea. Decided jason, 2026-10-22 (B-14)

keel.accent: the sea at three depths, one hue: shallows, harbor, depth
